description: Organizers' FNO checkpoint, frozen, with a per-pixel fluctuation gain, a running bias and closed-form interval bounds.
components_added: GAIN (gain map, running bias, closed-form bounds)
notes: First recorded result. The 2026-09-03 first_test and 2026-09-04 enkf-fno uploads have no recorded result. Upload date from the development notes (not published).

description: Gain-map pipeline plus a learned energy net, a separate interval centre, an advected copy of the last frame and an (Re, AoA) prior.
notes: Not kept (board stays at 79.06). Accuracy and sps rose; time fell because the convection-speed scan synced with the host 82 times per step (about 56 ms/step). The zip uploaded that day is not identified: the manifest sha (dff470a8) is of a later repack.

description: Same weights; the convection-speed scan batched on the GPU and run every 4th window.
notes: Time-only change. The zip was not tracked and has no manifest. Id and full-precision scores from the development notes (not published).

description: Online mean correction, a two-vector interval centre, and the flow-field energy net (ke_net_flow) in place of ke_net.
notes: Last upload on the organizers' FNO checkpoint. 2026-09-16_honest-backbone and 2026-09-16_knobs were packaged the same day; no upload is recorded for them.

description: Own ConvNeXt-UNet trained on all 81 real files, with causal context normalisation; online mean correction off; three output-identical speed changes.
notes: Rank as recorded: about 23rd of 48 September teams. Accuracy and sps rose; time fell (15.3 to 20.2 ms/step) because the UNet launches many small kernels.

description: UNet retrained with a Welsch (robust) loss; the step split into three CUDA graphs.
notes: Board step time 20.2 to 7.27 ms; most of the gain is time.

description: SimVP backbone (n1_simvp) with the S3 loss, energy-target blend and variance-preserving mean (D2), first conditional-width net (M1), nine CUDA graphs.
notes: Full-precision final 81.70106 (leaderboard snapshot in the development notes, not published). sps +0.95 (about +0.64 from M1); time 7.79 ms/step, slower than the day before. final_submission/realpde/submissions/ has a directory of the same name holding only cond_width_net.py.

description: Same weights and outputs as 09-20; outputs returned as unsynchronised CUDA tensors and static buffers shared.
notes: Not kept (board stays at 81.701). Time-only change: accuracy and sps identical to 09-20, time 8.39 ms/step. Showed that the official timer includes GPU work.

description: Whole step as one CUDA graph, GPU kernel cuts (T2), conditional widths refitted on cross-fitted residuals over all 81 files (W2).
notes: Predictions identical to 09-20; sps +0.324 from W2 alone; time 6.90 ms/step. Built on the second machine (RTX 4090).

description: Smaller SimVP backbone (b5) pretrained on the simulation data, plus graphs for windows 0/1 (W01) and a kernel diet (KD).
notes: Time about 6.40 ms/step. The b5-only and time-only archives were never uploaded, so the gain is not split between them.

description: Three-member packed ensemble, each member a weight average of four fine-tunes, fp16 core; interval centre blend (CB) with an adaptive weight (AW); adaptive width and energy blend (AX); gain clamp 20; exact scored mask (MSK); kernel diets KD2, KD3.
components_added: SOUP4 + K3 + FP16 + CB + AW + AX + GM20 + MSK + KD2 + KD3
notes: Ten components in one upload; no intermediate candidate was uploaded. Time 6.13 ms/step.

description: Beyond-range extension of the adaptive choices (AXE), regime-change reset (REC), kernel changes KD5/KD4, one-storage outputs (IPC); weights from a from-scratch retrain on the second machine.
notes: The code is the package in source_dir; the uploaded zip was built by a fresh-clone retrain on the RTX 4090. Accuracy subscores within ±0.02 of the prediction for the RTX 3090 lineage; time 6.22 ms/step.

description: 4-seed energy net (KE3), low-energy fluctuation damping (LOWKE), multi-stream graph schedule (KD6), exact fused kernels (KD7), transport levers IPW, CDIO and by-value outputs (BVR); RTX 3090 weights.
components_added: KE3 + LOWKE + KD6 + KD7 + IPW + CDIO + BVR
notes: Time 6.22 to 4.91 ms/step: about 0.7 ms attributed to by-value outputs, about 0.6 ms to KD6 + KD7 (A100 estimate). rel_l2 +0.046, tke -0.022.

description: Online least-squares correction of the ensemble head (LSK) with forgetting factor 0.97, its reset on a regime change, further fused kernels (KD8); weights identical to 09-26.
notes: Last development-phase upload; final_submission/ builds this lineage, which the organizers retrained for the Final Decision Phase (Track 2 winner). Time 4.84 ms/step. Id from final_submission/README.md.
